def transform(grid):
    g=[row[:] for row in grid]
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    from collections import Counter,deque
    bg=Counter(v for row in g for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    active=[any(v!=bg for v in row) for row in g]
    bands=[]; i=0
    while i<h:
        if not active[i]: i+=1; continue
        j=i
        while j<h and active[j]: j+=1
        bands.append((i,j)); i=j
    if len(bands)<2: return g
    # use first and last non-background bands of equal height
    top,bot=bands[0],bands[-1]
    if top[1]-top[0] != bot[1]-bot[0]: return g
    cnt=lambda band:sum(v!=bg for row in g[band[0]:band[1]] for v in row)
    src,tgt=(top,bot) if cnt(top)>=cnt(bot) else (bot,top)
    n=src[1]-src[0]
    # candidates are source marks lying to the right of the target row's last mark
    cand=set()
    for k in range(n):
        sr=src[0]+k; tr=tgt[0]+k
        occupied=[c for c,v in enumerate(g[tr]) if v!=bg]
        right=max(occupied,default=-1)
        for c in range(right+1,w):
            if g[sr][c]!=bg and g[tr][c]==bg:
                cand.add((sr,c,tr))
    # retain only candidates connected (in source coordinates) to another candidate
    coords={(r,c) for r,c,t in cand}
    connected=set()
    for r,c in coords:
        if any((r+dr,c+dc) in coords for dr,dc in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1))):
            connected.add((r,c))
    # expand whole connected components containing at least two cells
    q=list(connected); keep=set(connected)
    while q:
        r,c=q.pop()
        for dr,dc in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
            p=(r+dr,c+dc)
            if p in coords and p not in keep:
                keep.add(p);q.append(p)
    for sr,c,tr in cand:
        if (sr,c) in keep: g[tr][c]=1
    return g
